verdict.rationale: Twilio documents its own port-in capability: a no-code portability check and port-in requests for US non-toll-free numbers (up to 1,000 per request), so the core of porting a number in is delivered. The pack does not show Twilio collecting the losing carrier's account details or a letter of authorization, or filing the port on the user's behalf. missing for 10: evidence of losing-carrier account-detail collection, LOA capture/e-signature, Twilio filing the port with the carrier, coverage beyond US non-toll-free numbers, independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my existing number in: the provider collects the losing carrier's account details and letter of authorization and files the port
